intent: A generic HTTP-like message (method line, name/value header table, content body) used both for real HTTP and as Bedrock's internal command/message wire format.

objects.name: SData
objects.role: methodLine/nameValueMap/content; map-like accessors; calc/test helpers; getVerb; serialize/deserialize to HTTP wire format

misfits.why: unconditionally reserves 32 extra bytes on any JSON-looking header value to satisfy simdjson's trailing-scratch-space requirement; a generic HTTP message container shaping its storage to one downstream JSON parser's needs
misfits.suggested_home: wherever the simdjson parsing of these values actually happens

misfits.why: marked **DEPRECATED** in favor of the constructor but still present as public API
